DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //wvm.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 112 s. 2022 October 4, 2022 Dir. JUAN JOVIAN E. INGENIERO Regional Director, DILG-VI Pepita Aquino Street Fort San Pedro, Iloilo City Dear RD Ingeniero: This refers to your Memorandum dated April 4, 2022 concerning the alleged double compensation of ex-officio member of Victorias City, Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Negros Occidental. At the outset, may we note that we are not furnished with a copy of the subject Letter- complaint dated December 21, 2021. Be that as it may, we deemed apt to reproduce herein the pertinent facts disclosed in your Memorandum, viz: • Punong Barangay Juvy Pepillio (PB Pepillio, hereafter) of Brgy. 9, Victorias City was elected as representative of the Liga ng mga Barangay to the City Council of Victorias City; Due to vacancy, Brgy/ Kagawad Richard Julius Sablan assumed the position and became Punong Barangay; PB Pepillio was again chosen as ABC Chairperson giving her a seat at the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Negros Occidental; Due to another vacancy, PB Sablan occupied the position of a City Councilor as ABC President of Victorias City. It is alleged that the City of Victorias is "paying two (2) persons occupying two (2) positions as Ex-Officio Officer of Victorias City, one is the Sangguniang Panlalawigan Representative and the other, the Sangguniang Panlungsod representative"; Accordingly, in another letter dated 24 February 2022, Mr. James Francis Antony S. Garcia and Mr. Joel P. Garganera, representatives of concerned citizens of Victorias City further alleged that PB Sablan is illegally holding chairmanship of three (3) committees in the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Victorias City considering that SB Sablan [is] only an Ex-Officio member; Under such premise, arose the following issues for this Department's opinion: 1. Whether the City of Victorias is paying two (2) persons occupying two (2) positions as Ex-Officio Officer of Victorias City, one is the Sangguniang Panlalawigan Representative and the other, the Sangguniang Panlungsod representative; and 2 Whether ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Vitorias City can hold chairmanship position of any regular and standing mandatory committee(s). "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

On the first issue, we concur with your view that the same must be answered in the negative. As aptly cited, Rules 3.2-3.4 of the Local Budget Circular No. 66, series of 1998 issued by the Department of Budget and Management provide, thus: "3.2 The ex-officio members in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan representing the SK and the Liga ng mga Barangay shall receive the full amount of their authorized salaries and emoluments from the provincial government where they sit as ex-officio members. The province shall appropriate in full the requirement for the personnel benefits of concerned officials. Xxx 3.3. The respective Federation/Chapter Vice-President of the Liga ng mga Barangay and SK who sit in the Sangguniang Bayan as ex-officio members in lieu of the Federation/Chapter President who are elevated to the higher Sangguniang shall collect their full salaries and emoluments from the concerned municipal governments which they represent. The municipality shall provide in full the requirement for the personnel benefits of concerned individuals. 3.4 The Presidents of the Provincial Federation of Sanggunian Members of municipalities and component cities who sit as ex-officio members. in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan shall receive their authorized salary and allowances from the component city or municipality which they represent. The province shall appropriate only the difference in the salary and allowances of said officials such that their total compensation shall be equivalent to the compensation actually being received by their elective counterpart in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan." Accordingly, PB Pepillio, as the duly elected President of the Liga ng Barangay representative in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Negros Occidental shall receive the full amount of his authorized salaries and emoluments from the aforesaid Sangguniang Panlalawigan where he sits as ex-officio member. While the representative of the Liga ng mga Barangay chapter in the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Victorias (in lieu of PB Pepillio's elevation to Sanggnuiang Panlalawigan of Negros Occidental) shall receive his full salaries and emolument from the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Victorias. As to the second issue, relevant thereto is our opinion in DILG Legal Opinion No. 34, series of 2011 dated July 11, 2011, viz: "Ex-officio members of the sanggunian are assured of their respective committee chairmanship prescribed under the law. For example, the Liga ng mga Barangay Provincial Chapter President shall automatically hold the chairmanship of the Committee on Barangay Affairs (Article 108 (b) (1) of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of the Local Govemment Code). However, there is an exception to the said rule, that is, if the SP's duly approved Intemal Rules of Procedure (IRP) expressly allows the ex-officio members to do so. Hence, if your IRP allows ex-officio members to become members of the standing committees that may otherwise be Page 2 of 3

created by the SP, then this provision shall prevail. On the contrary, if your IRP limits the membership of ex-officio members to those allowed under the law, this provision prevails. If your sanggunian IRP failed to address the issue, the chairman and members for each committee shall be elected from among its regular members applying the general rule discussed above. " Notwithstanding, we would like to reiterate that the opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations narrated in the letter and our appreciation Of the same, and is being issued without prejudice to any contrary opinion, decisions, and orders of more competent authorities or the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, By the Authority of the Secretary: ATTY. NV R R.
